extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues: (1) 'sex' labels had extra spaces (' male', 'female ') which were normalized to 'male' and 'female'; (2) 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas (e.g. '4,800') and was converted to numbers; (3) three extreme outliers in 'body_mass_g' (4,400,000g, 4,950,000g, 3,500,000g) were excluded as they far exceed the valid range of 2500–6500g. Two duplicate rows were also removed. After fixes, the average body mass was 3,759.21g for females and 4,570.0g for males.
